title: Which streaming service will win the most Emmys?
description:
The 78th Primetime Emmy Awards, given by the Academy of Television Arts & Sciences, honor the best in American prime time television programming aired between June 1, 2025, until May 31, 2026. The awards ceremony is scheduled for September 14, 2026, at the Peacock Theater in Downtown Los Angeles, California

This market will resolve according to the streaming service which wins the greatest number of Emmys at the 78th Primetime Emmy Awards.

An Emmy will be attributed to a streaming service if the show for which the award is won is officially attributed to that streaming service, whether the recipient is a person, the show itself, or any other entity. For example, if Steve Carell wins "Outstanding Lead Actor In A Comedy Series" for his performance in "Rooster", that win would be attributed to HBO Max. 

In the event of a tie for the greatest number of Emmys, this market will resolve in favor of the streaming service whose listed name comes first in alphabetical order.

If all 78th Primetime Emmy Awards have not been awarded by December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve according to the Emmys awarded up until that point. If no Emmys are awarded by December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from the Television Academy, including data from their website (e.g., https://www.televisionacademy.com/), and the live broadcasts of the Creative Arts Emmys and the Primetime Emmy Awards ceremony. However, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description: HBO Max’s commanding lead in 2026 Emmy nominations (122 total) and frontrunner status for major awards have anchored trader consensus at 73% implied probability. The platform’s medical drama *The Pitt* (25 nods) and final-season comedy *Hacks* (24 nods) supply the bulk of its volume, positioning it to sweep drama and comedy categories in line with recent guild and critics’ momentum. Netflix trails at 111 nominations with anthology strength in *Beef*, while Apple TV’s 87 nods reflect breakout support for *Widow’s Bay* and *Pluribus*; both sit far behind in projected wins. With final voting concluded and the September 14 ceremony days away, the market reflects HBO Max’s edge in raw count and category depth rather than any late swing.
